scan_metadata.scan_scope: packages/ directory (excluding test assets and browser patches)
scan_metadata.notes: Flags are environment variables acting as feature gates in the Playwright source code. PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_* and PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_* configuration env vars were excluded as they are standard documented config options, not feature flags. PWTEST_* test infrastructure flags with boolean gate behavior are included. Companion env vars (PW_TEST_SOURCE_TRANSFORM_SCOPE, PW_TEST_CONNECT_HEADERS, PW_TEST_CONNECT_EXPOSE_NETWORK, PW_LANG_NAME_VERSION) are tracked under their primary flag entries.
